CWE-22.name: Path Traversal
CWE-22.summary: User input controls a file path, letting attackers read or write files outside the intended directory.
CWE-22.fix: Resolve the path against a fixed base directory, reject results outside it, and prefer opaque IDs over file names.

CWE-78.name: OS Command Injection
CWE-78.summary: Untrusted data is inserted into a shell command.
CWE-78.fix: Avoid the shell: use execFile/spawn (Node) or subprocess.run([...]) (Python) with argument arrays; validate against allow-lists.

CWE-79.name: Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
CWE-79.summary: Untrusted data is rendered as HTML/JS in the browser.
CWE-79.fix: Rely on framework escaping (JSX children), avoid dangerouslySetInnerHTML/innerHTML, sanitize trusted HTML with DOMPurify, and add a Content-Security-Policy.

CWE-89.name: SQL Injection
CWE-89.summary: Untrusted data changes the structure of a SQL query.
CWE-89.fix: Use parameterized queries/prepared statements; allow-list any dynamic identifiers.

CWE-95.name: Eval Injection
CWE-95.summary: Dynamically evaluated code can include attacker-controlled input.
CWE-95.fix: Remove eval/new Function; use JSON.parse or explicit dispatch tables.

CWE-200.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information
CWE-200.summary: Sensitive data is exposed to actors who should not see it.
CWE-200.fix: Return only required fields, apply authorization checks, and redact errors.

CWE-295.name: Improper Certificate Validation
CWE-295.summary: TLS certificate checks are disabled, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks.
CWE-295.fix: Keep verification enabled; configure trusted private CAs instead of disabling checks.

CWE-319.name: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information
CWE-319.summary: Data is sent over unencrypted HTTP.
CWE-319.fix: Use HTTPS/TLS for all non-local traffic and enable HSTS.

CWE-328.name: Use of Weak Hash
CWE-328.summary: MD5/SHA-1 are broken for collision resistance and unsuitable for passwords.
CWE-328.fix: Use SHA-256+ for integrity and bcrypt/scrypt/Argon2 for passwords.

CWE-338.name: Weak PRNG
CWE-338.summary: Predictable random numbers are used for security values.
CWE-338.fix: Use a CSPRNG such as crypto.randomBytes/randomUUID or secrets (Python).

CWE-489.name: Active Debug Code
CWE-489.summary: Debug features are enabled in production, exposing internals or consoles.
CWE-489.fix: Drive debug settings from environment configuration defaulting to off.

CWE-494.name: Download of Code Without Integrity Check
CWE-494.owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
CWE-494.summary: Code is downloaded and executed without verifying its integrity.
CWE-494.fix: Download, verify checksum/signature, review, then execute; pin versions.

CWE-502.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
CWE-502.owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
CWE-502.summary: Unsafe deserializers can execute attacker-controlled code.
CWE-502.fix: Use safe formats (JSON, yaml.safe_load) and never unpickle untrusted data.

CWE-532.name: Sensitive Information in Log Files
CWE-532.owasp: A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
CWE-532.summary: Secrets or personal data are written to logs.
CWE-532.fix: Redact sensitive fields before logging; use structured logging with deny-lists.

CWE-601.name: Open Redirect
CWE-601.summary: Users can be redirected to attacker-controlled sites.
CWE-601.fix: Redirect only to relative paths or an allow-list of hosts.

CWE-602.name: Client-Side Enforcement of Server-Side Security
CWE-602.summary: Security decisions are made in the client, where users can bypass them.
CWE-602.fix: Enforce authentication and authorization on the server; treat client state as untrusted.

CWE-732.name: Incorrect Permission Assignment
CWE-732.summary: Files or resources are readable/writable by unintended users.

CWE-798.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
CWE-798.summary: Credentials are embedded in source code or config.
CWE-798.fix: Load secrets from a secret manager or environment, rotate any exposed credential, and enable GitHub secret scanning push protection.

CWE-829.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
CWE-829.owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
CWE-829.summary: Third-party code (e.g. GitHub Actions) is referenced by a mutable version.
CWE-829.fix: Pin actions and dependencies to immutable commit SHAs; review updates via Dependabot.

CWE-942.name: Permissive Cross-domain Policy
CWE-942.summary: CORS allows any origin, letting other sites call the API with user context.
CWE-942.fix: Restrict allowed origins to an explicit configured allow-list.

CWE-1104.name: Use of Unmaintained Third Party Components
CWE-1104.summary: Dependencies no longer receive security fixes.
CWE-1104.fix: Replace deprecated packages and keep dependencies current with Dependabot.
